bio: A visit to this delightful village is definitely worthwhile! Originally a bakery and café, this family-run establishment has evolved into a restaurant serving flavoursome, meticulously prepared dishes that take their cue from the changing seasons. As well as à la carte options, there is a choice of set menus. The upscale setting has a classic aesthetic. Attentive service comes courtesy of a well-organised and adept front-of-house team. A must in the afternoon: the delicious freshly baked cakes! Pretty guestrooms....
